title: A little earth.
A little eternity.
home.lede: Colombian jewelry, made by hand. Every piece exists only once.
home.status: One piece. One story. One person.
home.statement: We make no jewelry in series. We create small ways to stay.
home.statementBody: The character of a stone, the gesture of the atelier, and a story just beginning: yours.
home.stonesSubtitle: Three stones. Endless ways to feel.
home.newestSubtitle: A selection of our newest pieces.
home.storyTitle: From the earth, to the atelier. From the atelier, to you.
home.storyBody: Every jewel begins with a conversation between a stone and the hands that shape it. Discover the origins of SERTI.
home.customTitle: Your story deserves a piece of its own.
home.customBody: An occasion, a memory, an idea. Let’s design a jewel that could only be yours.

editorial.prepareBody: Have your occasion, date, preferred stone and metal, size or length, approximate budget and reference photos ready.
editorial.inspiration: This one has found its person; yours is still to be made.
questions: How much does a custom piece cost?
Can I return a personalized piece?
answers: Price depends on the stone, metal and work involved. We will discuss your idea before quoting.
We confirm production and delivery times before beginning. Tell us about any special date.
